receipts.first_text_witness: There's a stack of envelopes on your kitchen counter. You know what's inside, which is why you haven't opened them in weeks. A hospital bill, a past-due notice, the amount in red, one of those windowed envelopes that's never good news, and somewhere in your brain, a voice has already written the ending. A repo truck idling at 6:00 a.m., a sheriff at your door, maybe a jail cell with your name on it.
receipts.last_text_witness: wakes up something that was already dead. So, tonight, do the one thing the little voice has been begging you not to do. Open the envelopes, sort them into their buckets, and handle them in the order that protects your life, not the order that yells the loudest. The monster under the bed was never a monster. It was a calendar the whole time. And now, you can read it.
